title: Concept: Atom created from input via String.to_atom (elixir) — review required
description: In elixir, String.to_atom creates atoms from runtime text. Atoms are never reclaimed, so unbounded input drives the VM past its atom limit and takes the node down. The remedy is String.to_existing_atom with a fixed allowlist.
applicability: elixir services converting external text to atoms; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Node crash and denial of service; MEDIUM severity.
